creative_direction: Show one pear embroidered directly onto a square of pale natural linen. The pear body uses golden ocher satin stitches that change direction across two broad sections, while its single leaf is worked in dark sage thread. A short brown stem and one tiny knot complete the fruit. Keep the silhouette uncomplicated and centered, with the linen visible on every side. Render the thread ridges clearly enough to distinguish them from painted lines, but do not add an elaborate border or hoop. A faint side light should reveal the shallow relief. No labels, initials, or decorative flourishes; the fruit and contrasting stitch directions provide the entire composition.
